scope: User-requested six-criterion rescreen of every frozen program, not filtering the previous nine A antigens
timing: Retrospective rule revision after existing response and disease results are known; drug reference retrieval precedes joint six-criterion selection
family: All 6849 frozen raw and relative programs / 213 biological antigens; original full-family P/q retained
C1: Interpretable antigen identity and observed antigen support in source-cell context; flag ambiguous lineage/mixed events for contextual review, without a protein-prediction rho cutoff
C2: Existing measured nondegenerate dose IQR > 1e-6; no new dose fitting
C3: Frozen program gene-decoy q <= 0.05; retain continuous seed diagnostics without extra gate
C4: Existing matched-cell-state Kamath/GSE157783 analysis: both evaluable, common actual disease direction, common relative competitive direction, pooled full-family meta q <= 0.05; Ma spatial sign not used
C5: Evidence of extracellular/cell-surface accessibility and an interpretable intervention route; verify molecular target identity, distinguish abundance intervention from pharmacological action
C6: Existing clinical drug or clinical-stage candidate with documented direct molecular target mechanism; approved subset reported separately. Exclude mere gene associations, endogenous ligands without therapeutic development, and scaffold/replacement proteins mislabelled as drugs against the scaffold gene
drug_source: Archived DGIdb for recall, ChEMBL direct mechanism/clinical phase for systematic verification, UniProt for molecular identity and accessible location; specific primary sources for exceptions
clinical_stage: Database maximum clinical phase is historical reached phase, not evidence of an ongoing trial or present marketing authorization
outputs: Per-program six statuses, cumulative funnel, all-antigen disposition, verified drug-target links, approved and clinical-stage strata, CD22/CD35 details, unresolved evidence list, source hashes
claim: Drug-supported peripheral target candidates; not predictions that a particular drug treatment has demonstrated brain efficacy
